mentions.name: Kexa
mentions.description: An open-source multi-cloud governance framework powered by a YAML rule engine that audits configuration and compliance of cloud resources (AWS, GCP, Azure, K8s) and now database (DB) instances. YAML rules are kept environment-agnostic so the same logic applies across different environments without rewriting.
mentions.audience: Developers auditing configuration and compliance across cloud and database resources
mentions.source_excerpt: An open-source multi-cloud governance framework powered by a YAML rule engine. We just reached a milestone by adding Database (DB) support.

evidence.value: An open-source multi-cloud governance framework powered by a YAML rule engine. We just reached a milestone by adding Database (DB) support.
